items.title: Author the corrected execution plan document with all 12 verified corrections
items.context: Create docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md as the corrected version of the deleted 2026-07-02 draft. Preserve the draft's structure (18 sections: problem, claim boundary, hypotheses, arms, populations, metrics, sample size, assignment, leakage controls, scoring, analysis, artifacts, milestones, verification matrix, no-overclaim, paper integration, execution order, definition of done) and its honesty scaffolding, while incorporating the 12 verified corrections: (1) per-population sample-size parameters (seeded-trap vs live) with powered N applying to the fault-bearing stratum only, clean tasks analyzed separately for overhead; (2) composite defect rate AND repeat-defect recurrence as co-primary on the fault-bearing seeded stratum, with the section-15 allowed claim reworded to match the tested metrics; (3) full-factorial matched-pairs design (both arms on every fixture, McNemar + paired bootstrap, committed run-order seed) for the controlled seeded phase, randomized assignment retained only for the live phase; (4) risk difference as the sole primary decision criterion, relative risk descriptive-only with a predeclared zero-denominator guard, BH-FDR predeclared across the H2-H5 secondary family, per-trap breakdowns labeled estimation-with-CI; (5) name and reuse existing components: hint-mode.ts/experience-hint-surface.ts (M3 arm switch), experiments/recovery-runner (M7 harness incl. run-driver/live-engine/resumable campaign), adjudicate.mjs/checks.mjs/analyze.mjs (M4 scoring / M5 statistics primitives incl. Wilson CI, cluster bootstrap, benjaminiHochberg); (6) remove Shadow C as an allocated arm — the production control arm already computes and logs the pack losslessly (experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts); keep control-side pack logging; (7) deterministic reviewer-free primary endpoint for seeded tasks (failed validation, false-DONE from structured DONE rows + final_response_check, task-oracle mismatch, structured lane-provenance check for the reviewer-lane trap); verified reviewer findings demoted to the live phase as secondary/exploratory; (8) artifact root under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/ with Proof-or-Stop scoped as the lifecycle-readiness concept, not a directory or command-set name; (9) split fault-bearing traps into in-store traps and held-out negative-control traps (lessons NOT in the runtime memory store) with the circularity limitation disclosed in the claim boundary and paper-integration sections; (10) mechanical store isolation: per-task non-git temp roots (mkdtemp, recovery-runner precedent) because learning-store resolveLearningRoot() canonicalizes linked worktrees back to the shared main-repo .lattice/learning store; freeze the memory-pack snapshot at protocol hash for the whole powered run and forbid experiment write-back; (11) per-trap enumeration and stripping/neutralization of in-tree answer sources (e.g. verify-lattice-residue.mjs, runbook prose) with a fixture-leakage audit added to the M6 pilot exit criteria; (12) a shared-resource scheduling note in the execution order (the s5/s6 powered run completed 2026-06-29, so no gating dependency; only avoid overlapping other live multi-day campaigns and note the weekly token-budget ceiling). Entire document in English.
items.userSees: Opening docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md shows: header "Status: draft execution plan (rev 2, 2026-07-02)" with a revision-provenance paragraph naming the 2026-07-02 adversarial review; section 4 contains "There is no separately allocated shadow arm"; section 7 contains a per-population parameter table with columns "Controlled seeded (fault stratum)" and "Live" and reference N rows "~29-58" and "~294"; section 8 is titled "Study Geometry: Matched Pairs, Not Blocked Randomization"; section 12 shows the artifact root ".lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/" plus mandatory "Store isolation" and "Memory freeze" subsections; section 13 has a "Reuses" column naming hint-mode.ts / experience-hint-surface.ts / experiments/recovery-runner / analyze.mjs; section 5.1 defines "Group 2 — held-out negative-control traps"; and section 15 includes the circularity disclosure sentence.

happy.desc: File exists at docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md, is valid markdown with 18 numbered sections, and each of the 12 adjudicated corrections is present at its designated section (checked one by one against the correction list in CHK-001 context) -> file present, 18 sections enumerable, all 12 corrections verifiable at their section numbers; WHY: the entire deliverable is the corrected document — completeness of the 12 corrections is the primary acceptance criterion

Every existing-component claim in the doc matches source: hint-mode.ts sha256 parity, experience-hint-surface.ts both-arms compute+log/render-gate, learning-store.ts resolveLearningRoot worktree canonicalization, recovery-runner mkdtemp + analyze.mjs Wilson CI/cluster bootstrap/benjaminiHochberg exports -> each named component exists at the claimed path and exhibits the claimed behavior; WHY: the plan depends on reuse of existing infrastructure — a misstated fact would lead a future milestone story to build against a wrong integration point

edge.desc: grep -Pn '[\x{3000}-\x{9FFF}\x{F900}-\x{FAFF}\x{FE30}-\x{FE4F}\x{FF00}-\x{FFEF}]' on the document -> zero matches (exit code 1, no output); WHY: english-open-source-surface gate blocks DONE on CJK characters in docs/requirements/decisions/

Every referenced repo path (scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs, experiments/recovery-runner/tasks, packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts, and any other repo paths cited in the doc) checked via test -e -> all exist; .proof-or-stop/ appears only inside the explicit rev-1 correction note, not as a live artifact root; WHY: dangling path references undermine the plan's credibility as a decision doc and would break future milestone build stories

adversarial.desc: No substantive design content beyond the 12 adjudicated corrections was introduced: diff rev-2 section-by-section against the preserved rev-1 semantics and confirm every delta maps to a numbered finding -> zero un-adjudicated design deltas found; WHY: guards against un-reviewed design entering a decision doc under a docs-only story that bypasses adversarial review

The no-overclaim rule survives intact and strengthened: sections 2/15/16 still forbid the four disallowed claims and now additionally disclose the answer-key circularity limitation -> all four disallowed claims present in the no-overclaim section, plus the circularity disclosure sentence; WHY: the no-overclaim rule is the plan's honesty scaffolding — if it is weakened or the circularity is hidden, the plan overpromises causal validity it cannot deliver

verificationEvidence.command: D=docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md; test $(grep -cE "^## [0-9]+\." $D) -eq 18 && grep -q "held-out negative-control traps" $D && grep -q "Study Geometry: Matched Pairs" $D && grep -q "There is no separately allocated shadow arm" $D && grep -q "lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/" $D && grep -q "Haldane-Anscombe" $D && grep -q "Benjamini-Hochberg" $D && grep -q "resolveLearningRoot" $D && grep -q "memory-snapshot-hash.json" $D && grep -q "fixture-leakage audit" $D && grep -q "2026-06-29" $D && grep -q "learning_effectiveness" $D
verificationEvidence.note: 18 numbered sections present and one distinctive marker per adjudicated correction found at its designated section: held-out traps (S5.1), matched-pairs geometry (S8), no allocated shadow arm (S4), .lattice experiments root (S12), RR zero-denominator guard (S11), BH-FDR (S11), worktree-canonicalization isolation rationale (S12), memory freeze artifact (S12), leakage audit (S9/M6), s5-s6 completion date in the scheduling note (S17), live-substrate reuse (S5.2/M8).

verificationEvidence.command: grep -q "firstByte % 2 === 0" packages/main/src/core/hint-mode.ts && grep -q "resolveLearningRoot" packages/main/src/core/learning-store.ts && grep -q "mkdtemp" experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs && grep -q "benjaminiHochberg" experiments/recovery-runner/analyze.mjs && grep -qE "hintMode === 'on'" packages/main/src/core/experience-hint-surface.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Every existing-component claim the doc relies on matches source: sha256 first-byte-parity arm switch, learning-root canonicalization, recovery-runner mkdtemp isolation precedent, benjaminiHochberg in analyze.mjs, render-gate on the ON arm.
Zero CJK characters (CJK unified ideographs, CJK punctuation, fullwidth forms) in the document; english-open-source-surface gate will pass.

verificationEvidence.command: test -e scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs && test -e experiments/recovery-runner/tasks && test -e packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts && test $(grep -c "proof-or-stop" docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md) -eq 1
verificationEvidence.note: All repo paths referenced by the doc exist, and the .proof-or-stop string appears exactly once — inside the explicit rev-1 correction note in S12, nowhere else.

Semantic trace check (every rev-1-to-rev-2 delta maps to one of the 12 adjudicated findings; no un-reviewed design content introduced) requires reading comprehension against the adjudication record and the preserved rev-1 semantics; not mechanically automatable. Deferred to the REVIEW lanes (docs + behavior reviewers) which re-verify delta-to-finding traceability; the commit message enumerates the 12 findings for that audit.

verificationEvidence.command: D=docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md; grep -q "Proofbound agents became smarter" $D && grep -q "Memory proves DONE" $D && grep -q "eliminates defects" $D && grep -q "Known circularity limitation" $D
verificationEvidence.note: All rev-1 disallowed claims survive in S15 and the new circularity limitation disclosure is present in S2 (plus the S15 required-disclosure and S16 paper sentence), i.e. the no-overclaim rule is intact and strengthened.
